svg.title: Algorithm Forge - build algorithms from scratch
svg.desc: Wordmark and tagline beside an insertion sort animation whose pseudocode highlight follows every compare and shift.
svg.text: see them, write them, prove them
Lessons, interactive simulations and a graded pseudocode
Arena — from first loop to the research frontier.
Levels 0 → 7 · runs in the browser · no installs
